column2: CSV Template for Class Schedule Import
This template uses day names instead of specific dates.
The system will auto-convert day names to actual dates.
Example: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
Required columns (in order):
1. facility  - Must match facility name in the system (e.g., SLAB1, SLAB2, Room 101)
2. day       - Day name (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday)
3. subject   - Subject code and name (e.g., "1478 IT1D ITE6102 Computer Programming 1 (LEC)")
4. start_time - Start time (7:30 AM, 10:30 AM, 1:30 PM, etc. - 12-hour format with AM/PM)
5. end_time   - End time (same format as start_time)
Important Notes:
- Facility name must exactly match what's in the system
- Day names are NOT case-sensitive: monday, Monday, MONDAY all work
- Times support: 7:30 AM, 10:30 AM, 1:30 PM, 4:30 PM, etc.
- The system will calculate the actual date from the day name
- Use "Replace existing schedules" option to clear old schedules before importing
